required.reason: Pinned-WPT-derived contract for nested same-document traversal and explicit reload. The native companion fixes bounded entry/state storage, reentrancy, generation/resource retirement and stable owner-facing WindowProxy behavior.

excluded.reason: The upstream traversal test depends on hosted multi-document session history. This contract preserves its asynchronous traversal and popstate boundary for bounded same-document child entries.
The upstream test requires POST navigation and the WPT server. This contract isolates GET child reload, retained session state and outgoing realm retirement.
